main_body: Large round leaf canopy (rows ~0-29) on a thin brown trunk with a dark green grass base patch
top_band: Canopy top: mid-to-light green clumps from row ~0 to ~8 form the upper dome surface, lit from the upper right, then shade darkens into the lower canopy mass
evidence: Organic canopy reads as a rounded volume with a lit upper dome and a darker underside; the lower canopy edge has a shadow row above the trunk, and the trunk stands on a dark ground patch. No receding side faces and no flat elevation. Organic kinds have no hard top-surface contract, and the lit dome over a shaded underside matches the 3/4 reading of the Beodeul trees.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 4 greens in blobby clumps with dark green outlines tinted toward the leaves, which is good. However, the clump edges are smooth and blocky, with no per-leaf highlight dots like the references' leafy edges. The trunk is a thin, flat brown column with only 2-3 tones and little bark texture, and the ground patch is a nearly flat dark green fill. Compared with the references, which have jagged leaf-clump silhouettes, visible branches in the canopy and a rooted flared trunk, this one is thinner and more sticker-like in the trunk and base, so it looks flatter next to them.
